title_ar: موهبتك المخفية: الشي اللي تحسبه عادي
title_en: Your hidden talent: the thing you think is ordinary
idea: Hidden talent sits in what people ask you for, what is easy for you but hard for others, and skills you think were wasted; ask others, then test the smallest version
business_angle: Turn a talent into a first paid offer without quitting or spending: free content first, a small product next
small_move: أرسل لخمسة يعرفونك: وش الشي اللي أسويه أحسن من أغلب الناس؟

title_ar: تموضعك: لا تكون الأفضل… كن الوحيد
title_en: Positioning: don't be the best, be the only one
idea: People choose the clear option: compare competitors to find the gap, narrow the audience, own one word, say it in one sentence
business_angle: Escape price wars: a clear position wins customers a bigger rival can't serve
small_move: اقرأ 20 تقييم سلبي لمنافسينك: كل شكوى فرصة
story_lead: Careem: Dubai 2012, cash when Uber took cards only; Uber buys it for $3.1B (2019)

title_ar: الثقة عملة: كيف تبني ثقة تبيع عنك
title_en: Trust is currency: build trust that sells for you
idea: Trust is built by small kept promises, admitting flaws, letting customers speak and fixing mistakes fast; it can be lost in seconds
business_angle: Trust shortens deals and brings referrals: a handshake closed a $50M+ deal without an audit
small_move: قل موعد التسليم… وسلّم قبله بيوم
story_lead: Mrs. B: about $500 in 1937 → Buffett buys most of her store on a handshake (1983)

title_ar: شبكتك ثروتك: العلاقة اللي تثمر بعد سنين
title_en: Your network is your wealth: connections that pay off years later
idea: Most opportunities come through acquaintances, not close friends: give first, keep weak ties warm, follow up within 24 hours, be patient
business_angle: A network brings jobs, partners and customers money can't buy; relationships compound for decades
small_move: رسالة متابعة خلال 24 ساعة من أي تعارف
story_lead: Abdul Latif Jameel & Toyota: one Land Cruiser (1955) → 250,000+ cars a year (1980s)
